Environmental Filters.description:

Stress Regulator.description:

Pain Gate Array.description:

Auxiliary Organ Cluster.description:

Smartgun Link.description:

Street Mantis Blades.description:

Reflex Cable Legs.description:

When you roll with Hope using a Medtech card or medical action, gain 1 Triage Charge, max 2. When you treat a target, spend 1 Charge to clear 1 Stress from it or 2 Charges to clear a HP from it.

When you roll with Hope using a Network card or hack action, gain 1 Daemon Charge, max 2. When you roll with a Network card or to hack, spend any Charges to roll that many d6s and add the highest result to the roll. If you spend 2 Charges and succeed, create 1 Breach.

Cortical Buffer.description:

Second Heart.description:

Ablative Dermal Shell.description:

Reflex Ghostware.description:

Neural Archive.description:
Cyberware 42 · Tier 3 · Cyber Cost 2

Gain a new Experience at +2 or add +1 to one of your Experiences. Once per rest, when you use that Experience, you may reroll your Fear Die.

Systems Module Bay.description:

When you roll with Hope using a Systems card or action involving devices, gain 1 Module Charge, max 2. Spend 1 Charge to add +1d6 to a roll involving devices. Spend 2 Charges to also repair, disable, connect, or modify one Close device after the action resolves.

Red Overclock Engine.description:
Cyberware 44 · Tier 3 · Cyber Cost 3

Half Access: Redline

Gain Half Access to Redline. When you roll with Hope using a Redline card, gain 1 Overclock Charge, max 2. Before a damage roll, spend any Overclock Charges to add +1d12 per Charge spent. If you spend 2 Charges, mark a Stress after the attack resolves.

Black ICE Cortex.description:
Cyberware 45 · Tier 3 · Cyber Cost 3

Half Access: Blackwall

Gain Half Access to Blackwall. When you roll with Fear using a Blackwall card, gain 1 Corruption, max 2. Before a Blackwall roll, spend any Corruption to roll that many d6s and add them to the roll. If you spend 2 Corruption and succeed, affected targets mark 1 Stress and become temporarily Degraded. While Degraded, the target uses a d12 instead of a d20 for attack rolls. Then mark a Stress or the GM gains a Fear.

Last-Chance Auto-Injector.description:
Cyberware 46 · Tier 3 · Cyber Cost 2

Once per long rest, when you mark your last Hit Point and would make a Death Move, take the Avoid Death Death Move. You fall unconscious, can’t move, act, or be targeted by attacks, and wake when an ally clears 1 or more of your marked Hit Points or when the party finishes a long rest. When you wake, roll your Hope Die. If the result is equal to or lower than your level, you gain a Scar.

Blackwall Co-Processor.description:

Full Access: Blackwall

If you spend 3 Corruption and succeed, one affected target marks 1 Stress, becomes temporarily Degraded, and can’t benefit from connected systems while Degraded. Then mark a Stress and the GM gains a Fear.

Gain one additional Hit Point slot and +1 Armor Score. When you take Major or Severe damage, roll a d6. On 5+, mark 1 fewer Hit Point.

Angel-Skin Plating.description:

Clone Reflex Loop.description:

Once per rest, when you roll with Hope on an attack, you can repeat the attack against another target within range for half damage.

Ghost in the Suite.description:

When you finish a long rest, choose Evasion, Armor, or Thresholds. Until your next long rest, gain one of the following: +1 Evasion, +1 Armor Score, or +4 damage thresholds. Once per long rest, when you spend Hope or mark Stress to use a feature, you don’t spend or mark it.

Norai Hermes-Arrow.description:
The Hermes-Arrow is a courier Eidolon built to cross kill zones before the enemy realizes the battle has moved.

Combat Style: speed, pursuit, and escape.
Sync Cost: 2 | HP: 6 | Evasion: 18 | Thresholds: 20/32 | Armor: 4
Movement: Far range — Glide, Boosters
Competency Link: Card Access — Frontier and Ghost

  • Vector Dash: This Eidolon may move anywhere within Far range, horizontally or vertically through jumps, boosters, and controlled glides. Once per scene, if you pass within Close range of an adversary, they mark 1 Stress.
  • Hermes Routing: Once per scene, when you roll with Hope on a movement, chase, escape, or pursuit action, clear 1 Stress.
  • Bolt Gun: built-in weapon with Far range, d8+5 physical damage. After a successful attack, you may move within Very Close range or temporarily Restrain the target.
  • Shock Kick: built-in weapon with Melee range, d8+4 techno damage. On a roll with Hope, push the target back to Close range or it becomes temporarily Vulnerable.

Mobilize: the Eidolon replaces your HP, Evasion, Thresholds, Armor, and weapons; your Hope, Stress, Experiences, and class features remain your own. The Sync Cost adds to your Cyber Load while synchronized, and the Competency Link only applies while synchronized.

Without a Soul Bond: mark 2 Stress and roll your Humanity Die; if the result is equal to or lower than your total Cyber Load, the synchronization fails.

Disabled (the Eidolon's last HP): Stay Inside, Hard Disconnect (2 Stress and a Humanity Roll), or Emergency Overclock (you mark HP in the Eidolon's place and 1 HP at the end of each action).

Eidolon Scale: against ordinary structures, vehicles, or machinery, the Eidolon's damage is one severity higher; small arms and low-grade threats deal one severity lower to it (not against elite adversaries, anti-armor weapons, military vehicles, other Eidolons, or Blackwall entities).

Mobilize from the Chrome tab of the Edgeheart Sheet.

EMP Charge.description: Make an Interface Roll against a connected device, drone, vehicle, or cyberware-linked target within Close range. On a success, it marks 1 Stress or becomes briefly disabled.

Breach Gel.description: Use on a door, wall, barricade, lock, or vehicle panel. It opens, weakens, or creates an entry point after a few moments.

Med-Gel Slab.description: During a rest, one creature clears 1 HP or 2 Stress.

Overclock Round.description: The next successful ranged weapon attack deals +1d8 techno damage. On a roll with Fear, mark a Stress.

Shock Mine.description: Place on a surface. The next creature who moves within Melee range of it marks 1 Stress and becomes temporarily Vulnerable.

Anti-Toxin Cartridge.description: Immediately clear poison, contamination, chemical exposure, or a similar temporary condition.

Hardlight Patch.description: The next time you mark an Armor Slot before your next rest, reduce severity by one additional threshold.

Black ICE Shard.description: Spend before an Interface Roll. On a success, create one additional Breach. On a roll with Fear, mark 1 Stress.

Adrenal Plug.description: When you would mark your last Hit Point, use this to stay conscious until the scene ends. Then mark 2 Stress.

Smart Ammo.description: The next successful weapon attack with a firearm can hit another target within Very Close range for half damage.

Sonic Spike.description: All creatures within Very Close range of the target point mark 1 Stress, and fragile glass, sensors, or exposed electronics break.

Cloak Mist.description: Become Hidden until you move into clear sight, attack, or the GM spends a Fear to reveal your position.

Redline Dose.description: Add +1 Proficiency to your next damage roll. After the attack resolves, roll your Humanity Die. If the result is below your Cyber Load, mark 1 Stress.

Hard Reset Ampoule.description: Clear one temporary physical condition from yourself or a creature within Melee range. The target becomes temporarily Vulnerable until their next action.

Breach Spike.description: Use before an Interface Roll against a simple connected system. On a success, create one additional Breach.

Signal Flare.description: Reveal your location to all allies in the scene and clear Hidden from creatures within Close range of the flare.

Nanowire Saw.description: Cut through a mundane lock, cable, restraint, vent, fence, or light barrier after a few moments of work.

Foamcrete Canister.description: Create temporary cover, seal a doorway, patch a breach, or block a small passage within Close range.

Decoy Transponder.description: Until your next rest, one vehicle, drone, device, or creature carrying this transponder appears under a false identity to simple scanners.

Kinetic Booster.description: Move within Far range and ignore difficult terrain during that movement. Afterward, mark 1 Stress.

Cryo Pack.description: When you or an ally within Melee range would take fire, heat, acid, or explosive damage, reduce the severity by one threshold.

Patch Plate.description: Immediately clear 1 Armor Slot from yourself, an ally within Melee range, or a Damaged vehicle.

Smart Grenade.description: Choose a point within Far range. All adversaries within Very Close range of that point must make a Reaction Roll (14). On a failure, they mark 1 Stress and become temporarily Vulnerable.

Ghost Tag.description: Use when you enter a restricted, surveilled, or guarded area. Until your next Spotlight, cameras and basic sensors treat you as authorized or harmless.

Blackout Capsule.description: Disable lights, simple cameras, cheap sensors, and unsecured displays within Close range until your next Spotlight.

Adrenal Inhaler.description: Gain advantage on your next action roll. After the roll resolves, mark 1 Stress.

Anti-Hack Token.description: Use when a trace, hack, scan, or hostile signal would affect you or your gear. Roll a d6. On 4+, the effect fails.

Door Eater.description: Apply this chemical charge to a door, wall, barricade, vehicle panel, or lock. After a few moments, it creates a person-sized opening or destroys the lock.

Shock Leash.description: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal no damage, but the target becomes temporarily Restrained.

Memory Wipe Tab.description: Use after a short conversation with a minor NPC. They forget one small detail from the interaction unless it would obviously endanger them.

Prototype Battery.description: Recharge one expended Loot item that works through power, signal, drones, hardlight, scanners, or electronics, allowing it to be used one additional time before your next rest.

Panic Button.description: Use when you would be captured, cornered, or separated. An alarm, ally signal, emergency beacon, or preplanned escape protocol immediately activates.

Assault Carbine.description: Controlled Fire: On a roll with Hope, gain a +1 bonus to your next attack roll within the scene.

Compact SMG.description: Spray: Mark a Stress to target another creature within Very Close range of your original target.

Street Shotgun.description: Scatter: On a successful attack, another target within Very Close range of the target marks 1 Stress.

Breach Hammer.description: Breach: On a successful attack against an object, door, barricade, cover, or vehicle, add +1 Proficiency.

Mono-Katana.description: Clean Cut: When you deal Major damage, the target also marks 1 Stress.

Smartbow.description: Draw: If you didn’t move during your Spotlight before attacking, gain a +2 bonus to the attack roll.

Shock Baton.description: Shock Pulse: On a successful attack, the target has disadvantage on the next Reaction Roll they make.

Scrap Launcher.description: Junkshot: On a roll with Fear, the target takes 1d6 damage and the weapon becomes jammed until you mark a Stress to clear it.

Military Rifle.description: Aim Down: Mark a Stress to attack a target up to Very Far range with advantage.

Riot Shotgun.description: Crowd Breaker: On Major damage, all adversaries within Very Close range of the target must move away or mark 1 Stress.

Pulse Halberd.description: Reach Arc: On a roll with Hope, another target in a line within range marks 1 Stress.

Vibroblade.description: Vibrating Edge: When you roll a 1 on a damage die, treat it as a 6.

Arc Caster.description: Chain Signal: On a successful attack with Hope, deal half damage to another connected target within Close range.

Heavy Nailgun.description: Impale: On Severe damage, the target becomes temporarily Restrained.

Smart Pistol Rig.description: Target Assist: On a miss, you may spend a Hope to reroll your Hope or Fear die.

Sonic Cutter.description: Resonance: On a successful attack, spend a Hope to make the target temporarily Vulnerable.

Rail Rifle.description: Rail Punch: On Major or Severe damage, ignore any damage reduction.

Auto-Shotgun.description: Double Barrel: Roll damage twice and take the higher result.

Plasma Carbine.description: Overheat: Mark a Stress before attacking to add 1d6 techno damage. On a success with Hope, the target is temporarily Overheated and take an extra 2d6 techno damage when they act.

Paired Techblades.description: Flowing Cut: On a successful attack with Hope, other adversaries within Melee range take half the damage dealt or you gain a +1 bonus to Evasion against the next attack targeting you.

Gravity Maul.description: Crater: On a successful attack, all targets within Very Close range of the target must mark 1 Stress.

Drone Spear.description: Return Flight: After attacking, this weapon returns to you and you may immediately reposition within Very Close range.

Black ICE Projector.description: System Bite: On a roll with Hope, the target becomes temporarily Degraded and roll a d12 instead of a d20 for their attack rolls.

Runner Whip.description: Lash Field: On a successful attack, pull the target into Melee range or push them back to Close range and create a Breach against the target.

Prototype Railcannon.description: Linebreaker: This attack targets all adversaries in a line within range.

Smart Stormrifle.description: Auto Aim: Spend up to 3 Hope and attack the same number of targets within range. Roll once for every target.

Siege Shotgun.description: Room Clearer: On Major or Severe damage, all adversaries within Close range must move away from you and become temporarily Vulnerable.

Steel-Whip Guillotine.description: Sever: When you roll maximum value on any damage die, the target marks 1 Stress.

Singularity Hammer.description: Collapse Point: On a successful attack, spend 2 Hope to pull all targets within Very Close range of the target into Melee range with them and deal half damage to the targets.

Neural Lance.description: Mind Spike: On Major or Severe damage, the target can’t target anyone beyond Very Close range until your next action.

Blackwall Emitter.description: Red Static: On a roll with Fear, you may add +1 Proficiency to the damage roll, then mark 1 Stress.

Stormblade.description: Blink Cut: On a successful attack with Hope, teleport within Close range and become Hidden until your next action.

Holdout Pistol.description: Quickdraw: You don’t mark Stress to equip this weapon in danger.

Combat Knife.description: Paired: +2 to primary weapon damage against targets within Melee range.

Shock Glove.description: Touch Arc: On a roll with Hope, the target marks 1 Stress.

Grapple Wire.description: Hooked: On a successful attack, pull the target into Melee range or pull yourself to Very Close range of them.

Smoke Popper.description: Smoke: Mark a Stress to deploy smoke within Very Close range and become Hidden while inside the smokescreen.

Tactical Drone.description: Spotter: Spend a Hope to give your next primary weapon attack a +2 bonus.

Stun Dart.description: Sedative: On Major damage, the target has disadvantage on their next action roll.

Heavy Pistol.description: Heavy Round: On Major damage, add +1 Proficiency to the damage roll.

Mono-Knife.description: Serrated: When you roll a 1 on a damage die, it deals 6 damage instead.

Impact Shield.description: Protective: +1 to Armor Score; when you mark an Armor Slot, you may push one Melee attacker back to Close range.

Arc Knuckles.description: Jolt: On a successful attack, spend a Hope to make the target temporarily Vulnerable.

Micro-Net Launcher.description: Net: On a successful attack, deal no damage to make the target temporarily Restrained.

Signal Jammer.description: Scramble: On a successful attack against a target, they can’t benefit from sensors or remote support until your next action.

Watchdog Drone.description: Harrier: On a roll with Hope, the target can’t become Hidden or have advantage before your next action.

Flash Charge.description: Blindside: Mark a Stress to make all targets within Very Close range of the target temporarily Vulnerable until they act.

Hand Cannon.description: Reaction Shot: When an adversary within Close range fails an attack against you, you can make a reaction attack roll against it.

Phase Dagger.description: Ghost Edge: On a roll with Hope, this attack ignores physical cover or damage reduction.

Neural Spike.description: Pain Loop: On Major or Severe damage, the target marks 1 Stress.

Kinetic Tonfa.description: Counterweight: When an adversary attacks you, you can mark a Stress to gain a +2 bonus to Evasion against that attack. If the attack misses, the attacker marks 1 Stress.

Counter-ICE Shard.description: Rebound: When you roll with Fear on this attack, you may reroll your Fear Die or gain a Hope.

Hunter-Seeker Drone.description: Marked: On a successful attack, the next attack against the target gains a +2 bonus.

Concussion Pistol.description: Knockback: On a successful attack, push the target back to Close range. If they collide with something, they also mark 1 Stress.

Molecular Razor.description: Perfect Cut: On Severe damage, the target marks 1 additional Hit Point.

Bastion Shield.description: Bulwark: +2 to Armor Score; when an ally within Very Close range marks HP, you may mark an Armor Slot to reduce the severity by one threshold.

Synaptic Needle.description: Neural Crash: On Severe damage, the target has disadvantage on all rolls until the GM spends a Fear to clear this condition.

Gravity Chain.description: Dragline: On a successful attack, move the target anywhere within Close range of their current position.

Blackbox Injector.description: Exploit: On a roll with Hope, create a Breach against the target.

Assassin Drone.description: Silent Kill: If you are Hidden when you attack, add 1d8 to the damage roll.

Singularity Charge.description: Implode: On Major or Severe damage, all targets within Very Close range of the target are pulled into Melee range with them and take half damage.

Street Icon Fit.description: Recognizable: Once per scene, choose one creature who has heard of your reputation. Gain advantage on your first roll against them.

Ballistic Vest.description: Reinforced: When you mark your last Armor Slot, increase your damage thresholds by +2 until you clear at least 1 Armor Slot.

Riot Shell.description: Heavy: −1 to Evasion; Cover Brace: Mark an Armor Slot to gain a +2 bonus to Evasion against an incoming attack.

Hazard Suit.description: Sealed: You have advantage on rolls to resist smoke, poison, gas, contamination, disease, or environmental exposure.

Smartweave Coat.description: Adaptive: When you are targeted by an attack, you can mark an Armor Slot to give the attack roll disadvantage.

Gang Colors Jacket.description: Claimed: You have advantage on rolls to intimidate, negotiate, or avoid being challenged in gang territory, criminal spaces, or contested streets.

Armored Bodysuit.description: Stealth: You gain a +2 bonus to rolls you make to become or remain Hidden.

Reactive Mesh.description: Feedback: When an adversary damages you within Melee range, they mark 1 Stress.

Exo-Riot Plating.description: Anchored: You have advantage on rolls to resist being pushed, knocked down, moved, or Restrained.

Insulated Hazmat.description: Grounded: When you mark an Armor Slot against techno damage, reduce the severity by one additional threshold.

Ghostweave Cloak.description: Ghosted: When you become Hidden, you may also become invisible until you move.

Celebrity Armorweave.description: Spotlight Altar: Once per scene, you can make yourself the center of attention. Until your next Spotlight, allies have advantage on rolls to hide, escape, or act unnoticed.

Corporate Aegis Suit.description: Executive Defense: Once per rest, when you roll with Fear on a Reaction Roll, you can change it to a roll with Hope.

Reputation Mantle.description: Name Carries Weight: When you roll with Hope on a Presence Roll, one ally who can see or hear you clears 1 Stress.

Ceramite Plate.description: Heavy: −1 to Evasion; Ceramite: Before you mark your last Armor Slot, roll a d6. On a 5 or higher, reduce the severity by one threshold without marking an Armor Slot.

Trauma Armor.description: Life Support: Once per short rest, when you would mark your last Hit Point, you can instead mark a Stress.

Angel Skin Prototype.description: Emergency Halo: When you would spend a Hope to help an ally or use a defensive feature, you may mark an Armor Slot instead.

Holo-Reactive Mantle.description: Shifting: When you are targeted by an attack, mark an Armor Slot to give the attack roll disadvantage.

Nullweave Armor.description: Signal Dead: You can’t be targeted by sensors, drones, or remote systems beyond Far range unless you are already detected.

Street Regalia.description: Legendary Cyberpunk: Once per scene, when you would roll with Fear on a roll, you may change it to a roll with Hope instead.

Vagras Bulwark Harness.description: Very Heavy: −2 to Evasion; Walking Barricade: You count as cover for allies within Very Close range. When an ally within Very Close range is targeted by an attack, you can mark an Armor Slot to give that attack disadvantage.

Siege Exo-Frame.description: Difficult: −1 to all character traits; Fortified: When you mark an Armor Slot, reduce severity by two thresholds instead of one.

Luxurious Coat.description: First Impression: Once per scene, choose one creature. They must treat you as important, dangerous, wealthy, or worth listening to until proven otherwise.

Personal Firewall.description:
You have a encrypted device that can be loaded with a defensive firewall and held by you or an ally. Describe what it is and why it matters to you.

The firewall’s holder can spend a Hope to reduce incoming techno damage by 1d12. If the Firewall Die result is 12, the firewall burns out after it reduces damage this turn. It can be recharged for free on your next rest.

Signal Burst.description:
At the beginning of a session, place tokens equal to your Interface trait on this card.

Make an Interface Roll against a target within Far range and spend any number of tokens to release a concentrated burst of unstable code, signal noise, or weaponized feedback against them. On a success, roll a number of d10s equal to the tokens spent and deal that much techno damage to the target. Mark a Stress to replenish this card with tokens, up to your Interface trait. At the end of each session, clear all unspent tokens.

Threat Prediction.description: Your prediction software constantly analyzes hostile movement around you. Gain a bonus to your Evasion equal to half your Interface trait.

Thermal Hijack.description:
Make an Interface Roll against a target within Melee range. On a success, you force their implants ports to violently overheat. They take 1d20+3 techno damage and are Overheated.

When a creature acts while Overheated, they must take an extra 2d6 techno damage if they are still Overheated at the end of their action.

Ghost Ping.description:
Spend a Hope to release a hidden signal spider into a network that you can move anywhere within Very Far range.

While this protocol is active, you may see or hear through one connected device or feed inside that network as though you were there. You can transition between using your own senses and seeing through the orb freely.

If the network is severed, purged, fully offline, or protected by a stronger hostile system, this protocol ends.

Countermeasure.description: You can interrupt a technological or digital effect taking place by making a Reaction Roll using your Interface trait. On a success, the effect stops and any consequences are avoided, and this card is placed in your vault.

Shared Feed.description:
When you Help an Ally, they can spend a Hope to add one of your Experiences to their roll alongside your advantage die.

When making a Tag Team Roll, you can roll a d20 as your Hope Die.

Perceptual Spyware.description: Choose a target within Very Far range. You can see through their eyes and hear through their ears through a hacked sensory feed, neural bridge, surveillance implant, or signal parasite. You can transition between using your own senses or the target’s freely until you run another protocol or until your next rest.

Defensive Protocols.description:
Arc-Deflection: Once per long rest, spend a Hope to negate the damage of an attack targeting you or an ally within Very Close range.

Routine Lock: Target a object within Far range. That object’s operating routine is interrupted exactly where it is until your next rest. If a creature tries to reactivate it, make an Interface Roll against them to maintain this protocol.

Fire-Wall: Make an Interface Roll (15). On a success, create a wall of hostile signal, burning plasma, hard-light code, or automated suppression between two points within Far range. All creatures in its path must choose a side to be on, and anything that subsequently passes through the wall takes 4d10+3 techno damage.

Predictive Algorithm.description:
You can run predictive models to glimpse the most likely consequences of your actions.

Once per long rest, immediately after the GM conveys the consequences of a roll you made, you can rescind the move and consequences like they never happened and make another move.

Viral Cascade.description:
Mark 2 Stress to make an Interface Roll, unleashing a self-replicating attack on all targets within Close range. Targets you succeed against must make a Reaction Roll with a Difficulty equal to the result of your Interface Roll. Targets who fail take 2d8+4 techno damage.

Additional adversaries not already targeted by Viral Cascade and within Close range of previous targets who took damage must also make the Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d8+4 techno damage. This chain continues until there are no more adversaries within range.

Deep Trace.description:
You can open a signal channel with any person with whom you’ve made contact. Once you’ve opened a channel with them, they can speak back into your mind, comms, or neural feed. Additionally, you can mark a Stress to make an Interface Roll against them. On a success, you can receive an answer to one of the questions:

1- Where are they?

2- What are they doing?

3- What are they afraid of?

4- What do they cherish most?

Retaliation Daemon.description:
Mark an adversary within Close range with a daemon. The GM gains a Fear. When the marked adversary deals damage to you or your allies, place a d8 on this card. You can hold a number of d8s equal to your level.

When you hit the marked adversary, roll the dice on this card and add it to your damage roll, then clear the dice. This effect ends when the marked adversary is defeated or you run Retaliation Daemon again.

Optical Scrambler.description:
When you make a successful Interface Roll to run a different protocol, you can spend a Hope to becomeCloaked.

While Cloaked, you remain unseen if you are stationary when someone moves to where they would see you. When you move into or within an adversary’s line of sight or make an attack, you are no longer Cloaked.

Network-Synced.description:
When 4 or more of the domain cards in your loadout are from the Network Competency, gain the following:

+1 bonus to your Interface Rolls. Once per rest, you can switch the results of your Hope and Fear Dice.

Mirror Stack.description:
Make an Interface Roll (14).

Once per long rest on a success, you create a stack of false targeting profiles, AR ghosts, signal echoes, movement loops, or false targeting data over your body that makes it hard to tell exactly where you are.

Mark any number of Stress to make that many additional layers.

When an adversary makes an attack against you, roll a number of d6s equal to the number of layers currently active.

If any roll a 5 or higher, one layer of the decoy loop is destroyed and the attack fails.

If all the results are 4 or lower, you take the damage and this protocol ends.

Signal Rebound.description:
When you would take techno damage, you can spend any number of Hope to roll that many d6s.

If any roll a 6, the attack is reflected back to the attacker, dealing the damage to them instead.

Remote Trojan.description:
Once per rest, make an Interface Roll (15).

On a success, drop into a remote spyware that lets you clearly see and hear any place you have been before as though you are standing there in this moment.

You can move freely in this spyware and are not constrained by the physics or impediments of a physical body. This protocol cannot be detected by mundane or technological means. You drop out of this feed upon taking damage or running another protocol.

Hard Shutdown.description:
Make an Interface Roll (16).

Once per rest on a success, all targets within Very Far range make a Reaction Roll (18).

Targets who fail take 3d10+8 techno damage and are temporarily Vulnerable. Targets who succeed take half damage.

Additionally, when you succeed on the Interface Roll, all terrain within Very Far range becomes Offline. While within an Offline range, targets cannot spend Fear and rolls with Fear do not generate Fear for the DM.

Botnet Cataclysm.description:
Make an Interface Roll against all adversaries within Far range.

Mark any number of Stress to wake every compromised process, stolen credential, old virus, hijacked device, corrupted server, dead account, and sleeper daemon you have seeded into the local network.

Targets you succeed against take 1d20+2 physical damage for each Stress marked.

On a success with Hope, choose one affected target. They are also locked out of all connected system, weapon mode, drone link, cyberware feature, or tactical support effect until their next Spotlight.

Probability Rewrite.description:
After you or a willing ally make any roll, you can spend 5 Hope to rewrite the outcome through predictive modeling, tactical misdirection, and perfectly timed intervention and change the numerical result of that roll to a result of your choice instead.

The result must be plausible within the range of the dice.

Get Back Up.description: When you take Severe damage, you can mark a Stress to reduce the severity by one threshold.

Corrective Aim.description: When you roll your damage dice, you can reroll any 1s or 2s.

Sweep Fire.description:
When you make a successful attack against a target within Very Close range, you can spend a Hope to use the attack against all other targets within Very Close range.

All additional adversaries you succeed against with this ability take half damage.

War Buddy.description: Once per long rest, when you compliment someone or ask them about something they’re good at, you can both gain 3 Hope.

Danger Close.description: Mark a Stress to gain advantage on an attack.

Adaptive Weapon Handling.description:
You can use a different character trait for an equipped weapon, rather than the trait the weapon calls for.

When you deal damage, you can mark a Stress to use the maximum result of one of your damage dice instead of rolling it.

Emergency Breakaway.description: Once per rest, when a creature within Melee range would deal damage to you, you can avoid the attack and safely move out of Melee range of the enemy.

Target Lock.description: Once per rest, you can apply all your focus toward a target of your choice. Until you attack another creature, you defeat the target, or the battle ends, gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency.

Reinforced Combat Armor.description: While you are wearing armor, gain a +2 bonus to your damage thresholds.

Ace’s Edge.description:
When you critically succeed on an attack, you can spend up to 3 Hope and choose one of the following options for each Hope spent:

You clear a Hit Point.

You clear an Armor Slot.

The target must mark an additional Hit Point.

You can’t choose the same option more than once.

Combat Conditioning.description:
When you choose this card, permanently gain two of the following benefits:

One Stress slot.

One Hit Point slot.

+2 bonus to your damage thresholds.

Then place this card in your vault permanently.

Last Stand.description: Once per long rest when you would make a Death Move, you can spend a Hope to clear a Hit Point instead.

Overpressure.description:
Before you make an attack, you can mark a Stress to gain a bonus to your damage roll equal to twice your Strength.

You can use Overpressure twice per attack.

Assault-Synced.description:
When 4 or more of the domain cards in your loadout are from the Assault Competency, gain the following:

+2 bonus to your attack rolls.

+4 bonus to your Severe damage threshold.

Grazing Fire.description: When you fail an attack, you can mark a Stress to deal weapon damage using half your Proficiency.

Rally Signal.description:
Once per long rest, while you’re charging into danger, you can muster a rousing call, broadcast, gesture, or squad signal that inspires your allies. All allies who can hear you each clear a Stress and gain a Hope.

Additionally, your allies gain advantage on attack rolls until you or an ally rolls a failure with Fear.

Kill Mode.description:
Once per long rest, you can enterKill Mode until there are no more adversaries within sight.

While inKill Mode, you can’t use Armor Slots, and you gain a +10 bonus to your damage rolls and a +8 bonus to your Severe damage threshold.

Blood and Chrome.description:
When you critically succeed on a weapon attack, gain an additional Hope or clear an additional Stress.

Additionally, when you deal enough damage to defeat an enemy, gain a Hope or clear a Stress.

Execution Protocol.description:
Once per long rest, spend a Hope to make an attack roll.

The GM tells you which targets within range it would succeed against.

Choose one of these targets and force them to mark 5 Hit Points.

Walking Arsenal.description: When you make a successful attack against an adversary, you can mark 4 Stress to force the target to mark a number of Hit Points equal to the number of Hit Points you currently have marked instead of rolling for damage.

Relentless Assault.description:
When you successfully make an attack with your weapon, you never deal damage beneath a target’s Major damage threshold. The target always marks a minimum of 2 Hit Points.

Additionally, when a creature within your weapon’s range deals damage to an ally with an attack that doesn’t include you, you can mark a Stress to force them to make a Reaction Roll (15).

On a failure, the target must mark a Hit Point.

Boosted Maneuvers.description: Once per rest, mark a Stress to sprint anywhere within Far range without making an Agility Roll to get there. If you end this movement within Melee range of an adversary and immediately make an attack against them, gain a +1 bonus to the attack roll.

Quick Thinking.description: When you’re targeted by an attack made from beyond Melee range, you can mark a Stress to roll a d4 and gain a bonus to your Evasion equal to the result against the attack.

Gripware Override.description: Spend a Hope to allow a creature you can touch to climb on walls and ceilings as easily as walking on the ground. This lasts until the end of the scene or you run Gripware Override again.

Strategic Approach.description:
After a long rest, place a number of tokens equal to your Knowledge on this card, minimum 1.

The first time you move within Close range of an adversary and make an attack against them, you can spend one token to choose one of the following options:

You make the attack with advantage.

You clear a Stress on an ally within Melee range of the adversary.

You add a d8 to your damage roll. When you take a long rest, clear all unspent tokens.

Combat Drive.description: When you cause an adversary to mark 1 or more Hit Points, you can spend 2 Hope to increase your Evasion by the number of Hit Points they marked. This bonus lasts until after the next attack made against you.

Bracing Frame.description: When you mark an Armor Slot to reduce damage, you can mark a Stress to mark an additional Armor Slot.

Jumpjet Protocol.description:
Make an Agility Roll (15). On a success, place a number of tokens equal to your Agility on this card, minimum 1.

When you make an action roll while flying, spend a token from this card. After the action that spends the last token is resolved, you descend to the ground directly below you.

Kinetic Boost.description: Mark a Stress to boost off a willing ally within Close range, fling yourself into the air, and perform an aerial attack against a target within Far range. You have advantage on the attack, add a d10 to the damage roll, and end your move within Melee range of the target.

Reflex Redirect.description: When an attack made against you from beyond Melee range fails, roll a number of d6s equal to your Proficiency. If any roll a 6, you can mark a Stress to redirect the attack to damage an adversary within Very Close range instead.

Combat Scan.description:
When observing a creature, you can make an Instinct Roll against them. On a success, spend a Hope and ask the GM for one set of information about the target from the following options:

Their unmarked Hit Points and Stress.

Their Difficulty and damage thresholds.

Their tactics and standard attack damage dice.

Their features and Experiences.

Additionally on a success, you can mark a Stress to remove a Fear from the GM’s Fear Pool.

Signature Move.description:
Name and describe your signature combat move.

Once per rest, when you perform this signature move as part of an action you’re taking, you can roll a d20 as your Hope Die.

On a success, clear a Stress.

Rapid Riposte.description: When an attack made against you from within Melee range fails, you can mark a Stress and seize the opportunity to deal the weapon damage of one of your active weapons to the attacker.

Recovery Cycle.description:
During a short rest, you can choose a long rest downtime move instead.

You can spend a Hope to let an ally do the same.

Chrome-Synced.description:
When 4 or more of the domain cards in your loadout are from the Chrome Competency, gain the following:

+1 bonus to Agility.

Once per rest, you can spend 3 Hope to cause an attack that succeeded against you to fail instead.

Cruel Precision.description: When you make a successful attack with a weapon, gain a bonus to your damage roll equal to either your Finesse or Agility.

Crowd Control.description:
Make an Agility Roll against all targets within Close range.

Spend a Hope to move targets you succeed against, and any willing allies within Close range, to another point within Close range.

Breaking Blow.description: When you make a successful attack, you can mark a Stress to make the next successful attack against that same target deal an extra 2d12 damage.

On the Brink.description: When you have 2 or fewer Hit Points unmarked, you don’t take Minor damage.

Splintering Strike.description:
Spend a Hope and make an attack against all adversaries within your weapon’s range.

Once per long rest, on a success against any targets, add up the damage dealt, then redistribute that damage however you wish between the targets you succeeded against.

When you deal damage to a target, roll an additional damage die and add its result to the damage you deal to that target.

Deathrun.description:
Spend 3 Hope to run a straight path through the battlefield to a point within Far range, making an attack against all adversaries within your weapon’s range along that path.

Choose the order in which you deal damage to the targets you succeeded against.

For the first, roll your weapon damage with a +1 bonus to your Proficiency. Then remove a die from your damage roll and deal the remaining damage to the next target.

Continue to remove a die for each subsequent target until you have no more damage dice or adversaries.

You can’t target the same adversary more than once per attack.

Swift Step.description:
When an attack made against you fails, clear a Stress.

If you can’t clear a Stress, gain a Hope.

Ava Utility Kit.description:
Power Push: Make an Interface Roll against a target within Melee range. On a success, they’re knocked back to Far range and take d10+2 techno damage using your Proficiency.

Reactive Plating: Spend a Hope to deploy reactive plates, smart-fiber reinforcement, or a temporary armor patch onto a target you can touch. They gain a +1 bonus to their Armor Score until their next rest or you run Reactive Plating again.

Spike Printer: Make an Interface Roll (12) to fabricate and launch a hardened spike, anchor bolt, kinetic shard, or compressed alloy projectile within Far range. If you use it as a weapon, make the Interface Roll against the target’s Difficulty instead. On a success, deal d6 physical damage using your Proficiency.

Illiat Software Pack.description:
Neural Lullaby: Make an Interface Roll against a target within Very Close range. On a success, you flood their nervous system, cyberware, or sensory feed with a sedative pulse. They’re Asleep until they take damage or the GM spends a Fear on their turn to clear this condition.

Arc Barrage: Once per rest, spend any number of Hope and fire micro-missiles, drone shots, smart flechettes, or compact energy projectiles that strike a target of your choice within Close range. Roll a number of d6s equal to the Hope spent and deal that much techno damage to the target.

Direct Message: Spend a Hope to open a line of encrypted communication with one target you can see. This connection lasts until your next rest or you run Direct Message again.

Tyfar Field Kit.description:
Wild Flame: Make an Interface Roll against up to three adversaries within Melee range. Targets you succeed against take 2d6 techno damage and must mark a Stress as a burst of flame, plasma, or volatile chemical spray erupts from your gear.

Utility Arm: You deploy a mechanical hand, drone claw, or remote manipulator with the same size and strength as your own within Far range.

Smoke Field: Make an Interface Roll (13) to deploy a temporary thick cloud of smoke, fog, signal chaff, or obscuring vapor that gathers in a stationary area within Very Close range. The fog heavily obscures this area and everything in it.

Sitil Disguise Rig.description:
Adjust Appearance: You shift your appearance and clothing with light-bending fabric, facial projection, skinmesh, or disguise tech to avoid recognition.

Target Splitter: Spend 2 Hope to activate this targeting assist on yourself or an ally within Close range. The next time the target makes an attack, they can hit an additional target within range that their attack roll would succeed against. You can only hold this protocol on one creature at a time.

Hard-Light Decoy: Make an Interface Roll (14). On a success, create a temporary visual projection, hard-light duplicate, false object, or tactical hologram no larger than you within Close range that lasts for as long as you look at it. It holds up to scrutiny until an observer is within Melee range.

Vagras Security Kit.description:
Smart Lock: Make an Interface Roll (15) on an object you’re touching that can close, such as a lock, chest, door, box, panel, safe, or case. Once per rest on a success, you encrypt, reinforce, and seal the object so it can only be opened by creatures with your password.

Someone with access to compatible technology and an hour of time to study the protocol can break it.

Emergency Door: When you have no adversaries within Melee range, make an Interface Roll (13). On a success, spend a Hope to open a short-range transit door, breach route, displacement panel, or emergency passage from where you are to a point within Far range you can see. It closes once a creature has passed through it.

Reveal: Make an Interface Roll. If there is anything technologically, digitally, or artificially hidden within Close range, it is revealed.

Korvax Control Suite.description:
Gravity Clamp: Make an Interface Roll to temporarily lift a target you can see up into the air and move them within Close range of their original position.

Memory Scrub: Spend a Hope to force a target within Melee range to make a Reaction Roll (15). On a failure, you overwrite, scramble, or suppress the last minute of their short-term memory, causing them to forget the last minute of your conversation.

Repulsion Circle: Mark a Stress to deploy a temporary repulsion field, shock ring, or kinetic perimeter on the ground where you stand. All adversaries within Melee range, or who enter Melee range, take 2d12+4 techno damage and are knocked back to Very Close range.

Norai Heavy Package.description:
Tether Clamp: Make an Interface Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, they’re temporarily Restrained and must mark a Stress. If you target a flying creature, this protocol grounds and temporarily Restrains them.

Firebomb: Make an Interface Roll against a target within Very Far range. On a success, launch an explosive payload, plasma charge, volatile shell, or drone-delivered bomb toward them that explodes on impact. The target and all creatures within Very Close range of them must make a Reaction Roll (13). Targets who fail take d20+5 techno damage using your Proficiency. Targets who succeed take half damage.

Exota Fabrication Suite.description:
Repudiate: You can interrupt a technological, digital, or techno effect taking place. Make a Reaction Roll using your Interface trait. Once per rest on a success, the effect stops and any consequences are avoided.

Deploy Construct: Spend a Hope to deploy an animated construct, drone cluster, jury-rigged machine, or autonomous hardware unit from them that obeys basic commands. Make an Interface Roll to command them to take action. When necessary, they share your Evasion and traits, and their attacks deal 2d10+3 physical damage. You can only maintain one construct at a time, and they fall apart when they take any amount of damage.

Displacement Route.description:
Make an Interface Roll (12). On a success, spend a Hope to trigger a short-range displacement route, emergency blink rig, phase-jump module, or tactical relocation system that moves you to another point you can see within Far range.

If any willing creatures are within Very Close range, spend an extra Hope for each creature to bring them with you.

Manifest Cover.description:
Make an Interface Roll (15). Once per rest on a success, spend a Hope to create a temporary wall, hard-light barrier, deployable barricade, kinetic shield, or instant structure between two points within Far range.

It can be up to 50 feet high and form at any angle. Creatures or objects in its path are shunted to a side of your choice. The wall stays until your next rest or you run Manifest Cover again.

Long-Range Extraction.description:
Once per long rest, you can instantly extract or displace yourself and any number of willing targets within Close range to a place you’ve been before using a recall beacon, displacement rig, or pre-mapped extraction point.

Make an Interface Roll (16) with the following modifiers:

1- If you’re familiar with the place: +3.

2- If you visit the place frequently: +1.

3- If you’ve visited the place once: +0.

4- If you’ve only been there once: -2. On a success, you arrive where you were intending to go. On a failure, you arrive off course, with the range of failure determining how far off course.

System Ban.description:
Make an Interface Roll against a target within Close range.

On a success, roll a number of d20s equal to your Interface trait. The target must make a Reaction Roll with a Difficulty equal to your highest result. On a success, the target must mark a Stress but isn’t banished.

Once per rest on a failure, they are banished from this battlefield, signal layer, or active physical space.

When the PCs roll with Fear, the Difficulty gains a −1 penalty and the target makes another Reaction Roll. On a success, they return from banishment.

Magnetic Override.description:
Make an Interface Roll against a target within Far range.

On a success, you use magnetic force, remote machinery, grav-tech, industrial drones, or a heavy manipulator array to move them anywhere within Far range of their original position.

You can throw the lifted target as an attack by making an additional Interface Roll against the second target you’re trying to attack.

On a success, deal d12+4 physical damage to the second target using your Proficiency.

This protocol then ends.

Homet Access Suite.description:
Phase Breach: Make an Interface Roll (13). Once per rest on a success, you and all creatures touching you can pass through a wall or door within Close range by using a phase module, molecular bypass, breach field, or emergency matter-shift route. The effect ends once everyone is on the other side.

Blacksite Gate: Make an Interface Roll (14). Once per long rest on a success, open a gateway to a sealed facility, hidden network layer, deep bunker, off-grid safehouse, restricted blacksite, or strange space you’ve been to before. This gateway lasts until your next rest.

Systems-Synced.description:
When 4 or more of the domain cards in your loadout are from the Systems Competency, gain the following:

You can mark a Stress to add your Proficiency to an Interface Roll. Once per rest, replace this card with any card from your vault without paying its Recall Cost.

Vyola Neural Suite.description:
Memory Delve: Make an Interface Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, peer into the target’s mind, memory archive, neural residue, or recorded perception and ask the GM a question. The GM describes any memories the target has pertaining to the answer.

Neural Loadshare: Once per long rest, spend a Hope to choose two willing creatures. You create a temporary neural support link between them. When one of them would mark Stress, they can choose between the two of them who marks it. This protocol lasts until their next rest.

Safehouse Deployment.description:
When you have a few minutes of calm to focus, you can spend 2 Hope to deploy, unlock, or reveal your Safehouse, a large hidden shelter, mobile base, bunker, or concealed operational room where you and your allies can take shelter.

When you do, a hidden entrance appears somewhere within Close range. Once inside, you can make the entrance invisible. You and anyone else inside can always exit. Once you leave, the doorway must be deployed again. When you take a rest within your own Safehouse, you can choose an additional downtime move.

Ronin Alteration Suite.description:
Adaptive Shell: Make an Interface Roll (15). On a success, wrap yourself in adaptive camouflage, smart-material plating, hard-light masking, or a compact disguise shell, transforming into an inanimate object no larger than twice your normal size. You can remain in this shape until you take damage.

Permanent Weakpoint: Once per long rest, make an Interface Roll against a target within Close range. On a success, they become permanently Vulnerable. They can’t clear this condition by any means.

Ultra Thermal Pulse.description: Make an Interface Roll (18). Once per long rest on a success, the GM tells you which adversaries within Far range have a Difficulty of 18 or lower. Mark a Stress for each one you wish to hit with this protocol. They are instantly killed.

Yarrow Master Suite.description:
Time Dilation Field: Make an Interface Roll (18). On a success, you trigger an illegal time-dilation field, perception overclock, or localized causality lag. Time temporarily slows to a halt for everyone within Far range except for you. It resumes the next time you make an action roll that targets another creature.

Techno Immunity: Spend 5 Hope to become immune to techno damage until your next rest.

Transcendent Link.description:
Once per long rest, spend 5 Hope to activate this protocol on two or more willing creatures.

Until your next rest, when a creature connected by this link would mark Stress or Hit Points, the connected creatures can choose who marks it.

Smooth Operator.description: Spend a Hope to gain advantage on a roll to deceive, mislead, bluff, trick, or convince someone into believing a lie you tell them.

Captive Audience.description:
Make an Interface Roll against a target within Close range. On a success, they become temporarily Captivated. While Captivated, a target’s attention is fixed on you, narrowing their field of view and drowning out any sound but your voice, broadcast, performance, or projection.

Once per rest on a success, you can mark a Stress to force the Captivated target to mark a Stress as well.

Rally Broadcast.description:
After a long rest, place a number of tokens on this card equal to your Presence. When you speak with an ally or give them direct encouragement, you can spend a token from this card to give them one benefit from the following options:

1- Your ally clears a Stress.

2- Your ally clears a Hit Point.

3- Your ally gains a Hope.

When you take a long rest, clear all unspent tokens.

Truth Filter.description:
Make an Interface Roll against a target within Very Close range.

On a success, they can’t lie to you while they remain within Close range, but they are not compelled to speak. If you ask them a question and they refuse to answer, they must mark a Stress and the effect ends.

The target is typically unaware this protocol has been activated on them until it causes them to utter the truth.

Public Provocation.description:
When you provoke, taunt, expose, or bait a target within Far range, make a Presence Roll against them.

Once per rest on a success, roll a number of d4s equal to your Proficiency. The target marks Stress equal to the highest result rolled.

Sensory Overload.description:
Make an Interface Roll against all targets within Close range of you. Once per rest on a success, create an overwhelming display of flashing ads, braindance static, sonic distortion, hard-light colors, or tactical projections that temporarily Stuns targets you succeed against and forces them to mark a Stress.

While Stunned, they can’t use reactions and can’t take any other actions until they clear this condition.

Voice of Authority.description:
You speak with unmatched confidence, command presence, or cultivated authority. You have advantage on action rolls to de-escalate violent situations or convince someone to follow your lead.

Additionally, you’re emboldened in moments of duress. When all of your Stress are marked, you gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for damage rolls.

Crisis Counseling.description: During a short rest, when you take the time to comfort, stabilize, coach, or emotionally support another character while using the Tend to Wounds downtime move on them, clear an additional Hit Point on that character. When you do, you also clear 2 Hit Points.

Bait the Mark.description:
Describe how you taunt, challenge, humiliate, expose, or bait a target within Close range, then make a Presence Roll against them.

On a success, the target must mark a Stress, and the next time the GM spotlights them, they must target you with an attack, which they make with disadvantage.

Thought Profile.description:
You can read patterns in others through microexpressions, voice stress, neural leaks, surveillance feeds, or emotional profiling.

Spend a Hope to read the vague surface thoughts of a target within Far range. Make an Interface Roll against the target to delve for deeper, more hidden thoughts.

On a roll with Fear, the target might, at the GM’s discretion, become aware that you’re reading them.

Discord Trigger.description:
Whisper words of discord, transmit a false order, exploit a rivalry, or trigger a behavioral command in an adversary within Melee range and make an Interface Roll (13).

On a success, the target must mark a Stress and make an attack against another adversary instead of against you or your allies.

Once this attack is over, the target realizes what happened. The next time you run Discord Trigger on them, gain a −5 penalty to the Interface Roll.

Never Off Camera.description:
When you mark 1 or more Hit Points from an attack, you can mark a Stress to place a number of tokens equal to the number of Hit Points you marked on this card.

On your next successful attack, gain a +5 bonus to your damage roll for each token on this card, then clear all tokens.

Talk To Me.description:
Once per rest, take on the Stress from a willing creature within Melee range. The target describes what intimate knowledge, emotional static, personal fear, or private memory leaks from their mind in this moment between you.

Transfer any number of their marked Stress to you, then gain a Hope for each Stress transferred.

Endless Charisma.description: After you make an action roll to persuade, lie, negotiate, perform, command, manipulate, or garner favor, you can spend a Hope to reroll the Hope or Fear Die.

Influence-Synced.description:
When 4 or more of the domain cards in your loadout are from the Influence Competency, gain the following:

You can mark an Armor Slot instead of marking a Stress.

When you would force a target to mark a number of Hit Points, you can choose instead to force them to mark that number of Stress.

Remote Persona.description:
Once per long rest, mark a Stress to create a projected copy, remote persona, hard-light avatar, hacked broadcast body, or social proxy of yourself that can appear anywhere you’ve been before.

You can see and hear through the projection as though it were you and affect the world as though you were there.

A creature investigating the projection can tell it’s artificial, digital, or technologically generated.

This effect lasts until your next rest or your projection takes any damage.

Mass Captivation.description:
Make an Interface Roll against all targets within Far range.

Targets you succeed against become temporarily Captivated. While Captivated, a target’s attention is fixed on you, narrowing their field of view and drowning out any sound but your voice, broadcast, performance, or projection.

Mark a Stress to force all Captivated targets to mark a Stress, ending this protocol.

Adaptive Persona.description:
Once per long rest, this card can mimic the features of another domain card of level 8 or lower in another player’s loadout.

Spend Hope equal to half the card’s level to gain access to the feature. It lasts until your next rest or they place the card in their vault.

Master of the Craft.description: Gain a permanent +2 bonus to two of your Experiences or a permanent +3 bonus to one of your Experiences. Then place this card in your vault permanently.

Signal Boost.description:
When an ally within Close range deals damage to an adversary, you can make an Interface Roll against that same target.

On a success, you deal the same damage to the target that your ally dealt.

If your Interface Roll succeeds with Fear, place this card in your vault.

Notorious.description:
People know who you are and what you’ve done, and they treat you differently because of it.

When you leverage your notoriety to get what you want, you can mark a Stress before you roll to gain a +10 bonus to the result.

Your food and drinks are always free wherever you go, and everything else you buy is reduced in price by one bag of cash, credit, barter, or gold, to a minimum of one handful.

This card doesn’t count against your loadout’s domain card maximum of 5 and can’t be placed in your vault.

Pick and Pull.description: You have advantage on action rolls to pick non-digital locks, bypass physical security, disarm traps, disable simple alarms, or steal items from a target, either through stealth or by force.

Throwing Blades.description:
Spend a Hope to make an Interface Roll and release a burst of throwing blades, microdrones, or suppressed smart-shards that strike out at all targets within Very Close range.

Targets you hit take d8+2 physical damage using your Proficiency. If a target you hit is Vulnerable, they take an extra 1d8 damage.

Digital Face.description:
When you have a few minutes to prepare, you can mark a Stress to apply a synthetic mask or smart-skin overlay matching any humanoid you have seen.

While disguised, you have advantage on Presence Rolls to avoid scrutiny. Place a number of tokens on this card equal to your Interface trait. When you take an action while disguised, spend a token from this card.

After the action that spends the last token is resolved, the disguise drops.

Wirebind.description: Make an Interface Roll against all adversaries within Very Close range. Targets you succeed against are temporarily Restrained by snare wire, smart restraints, adhesive gel, or hijacked security systems.

Shadow Asset.description:
Spend a Hope to deploy a silent infiltration asset, such as a microdrone, optical decoy, or assassination marker. Until your next rest, the Shadow Asset can quietly follow a creature, watch a location, create a distraction, or help you maintain cover. It can’t physically manipulate the environment.

When you make a action involving a creature or location watched by your Shadow Asset, you gain advantage. You can also burn the asset to strike an adversary. When you do, make an Interface Roll against a target within Very Far range.

On a hit, roll a number of d6s equal to your Interface trait and deal that much techno damage to the target. The Shadow Asset then dissipates.

You can only have one Asset at a time.

Ghost Skin.description:
Make an Interface Roll (10). On a success, mark a Stress and choose yourself or an ally within Melee range to become Invisible through optical camouflage, ghost skin, or sensor-scrambling tech.

An Invisible creature can’t be seen except through appropriate detection methods, and attack rolls against them are made with disadvantage.

Place a number of tokens on this card equal to your Interface trait. When the Invisible creature takes an action, spend a token from this card. After the action that spends the last token is resolved, the effect ends.

You can only run Ghost Skin on one creature at a time.

Blackout Veil.description: Make an Interface Roll (13). On a success, you create a curtain of darkness, signal chaff, or interference between two points within Far range. You’re considered Hidden to creatures on the other side of the veil, and you have advantage on attacks you make through the veil. The veil remains until you run another protocol.

Stealth Expertise.description: When you roll with Fear while attempting to move unnoticed through a dangerous area, you can mark a Stress to roll with Hope instead. If an ally within Close range is also attempting to move unnoticed and rolls with Fear, you can mark a Stress to change their result to a roll with Hope.

Weakpoint Tag.description:
Make an Interface Roll against a target within Very Close range.

On a success, spend a Hope to mark them with a hidden tracer, targeting glyph, or weakpoint scanner, temporarily reducing the target’s Difficulty by a value equal to your Interface trait, minimum 1.

Dead Drop Exit.description:
Spend a Hope to prepare a hidden exit where you’re currently standing, such as a service corridor, blind camera angle,or pre-planned extraction path. Until your next rest you can spend a Hope to trigger the exit plan.

When you do, you immediately move to the prepared exit or to a safe position within Very Close range of it, become Hidden, and this protocol ends.

This movement must follow a route that could plausibly exist in the fiction.

Hush Field.description:
Make an Interface Roll against a target within Close range. On a success, spend a Hope to deploy suppressive tech around the target that encompasses everything within Very Close range of them and follows them as they move.

The target and everything within the area is Silenced until the GM spends a Fear on their turn to clear this condition, you run Hush Field again, or you take Major damage.

While Silenced, they can’t make noise and can’t run comm protocols or use effects that require audible, verbal, or broadcast commands.

Black Route.description:
Make an Interface Roll (15). On a success, you map, open, or prepare a covert route through the area.

Until your next rest, you and any allies you guide can use this route to move between your current location and another one within Very Far range that you have already reached in this scene. While using the route, you and allies you guide have advantage on rolls to avoid detection, bypass mundane security, or escape pursuit.

This route stays available until you choose to close it or the GM spends a Fear to reveal that the route has been compromised.

Mass Disguise.description:
When you have a few minutes of silence to focus, you can mark a Stress to change the appearance of all willing creatures within Close range using false-face rigs, projected identities, smart-skin overlays, synthetic masks, or coordinated disguise tech.

Their new forms must share a general body structure and size, and can be somebody or something you’ve seen before or entirely fabricated.

A disguised creature has advantage on Presence Rolls to avoid scrutiny. Activate a Countdown (8). It ticks down as a consequence the GM chooses.

When it triggers, the disguises drop.

Ghost-Synced.description:
When 4 or more of the domain cards in your loadout are from the Ghost Competency, gain the following:

Once per rest, when you have 0 Hope and the GM would gain a Fear, you can gain a Hope instead.

When you make a successful attack, you can mark a Stress to add the result of your Fear Die to your damage roll.

Vanishing Dodge.description:
When an attack made against you that would deal physical damage fails, you can spend a Hope to trigger a smoke burst, ghost-skin flicker, phase jump, emergency blink, or optical displacement.

You become Hidden and move to a point within Close range of the attacker.

You remain Hidden until the next time you make an action roll.

Shadowhunter.description:
Your combat systems, instincts, and assassination training are at their best under low visibility.

While you’re shrouded in low light, darkness, smoke, heavy rain, dense fog, crowd cover, or visual interference, you gain a +1 bonus to your Evasion and make attack rolls with advantage.

Feedback Charge.description:
When you take techno damage, place tokens on this card equal to the number of Hit Points you marked.

You can store a number of tokens equal to your Interface trait.

When you make a successful attack against a target, you can spend any number of tokens to add a d6 for each token spent to your damage roll.

Fearmask.description:
Once per long rest, choose any targets within Very Close range to perceive you as a nightmarish threat, impossible assassin, corrupted sensor ghost, or fear-triggered hallucination.

The targets must succeed on a Reaction Roll (16) or become temporarily Horrified. While Horrified, they’re Vulnerable.

Steal a number of Fear from the GM equal to the number of targets that are Horrified, up to the number of Fear in the GM’s pool.

Roll a number of d6s equal to the number of stolen Fear and deal the total damage to each Horrified target. Discard the stolen Fear.

Studying the Victim.description:
Choose a target within Far range. When you succeed on an action roll against them that doesn’t result in making a damage roll, place a token on this card.

When you deal damage to this target, spend any number of tokens to add a d12 for each token spent to your damage roll.

You can only hold Studying the Victim on one creature at a time.

When you choose a new target or take a rest, clear all unspent tokens.

Total Blackout.description:
Make an Interface Roll (16). Once per long rest on a success, plunge the entire area within Far range into complete darkness, signal blackout, smoke saturation, sensor denial, or light-eating interference that only you and your allies can see through.

Attack rolls have disadvantage when targeting you or an ally within this blackout.

Additionally, when you or an ally succeeds with Hope against an adversary within this blackout, the target must mark a Stress.

This protocol lasts until the GM spends a Fear on their turn to clear this effect or you take Severe damage.

Specter Mode.description:
Mark a Stress to turn Spectral until you make an action against other creature. While Spectral, your body is wrapped in active camouflage, signal chaff, and predictive movement software. You are Hidden, you don’t trigger mundane cameras or alarms, and you can’t be directly targeted by physical attacks unless a creature is within Melee range or the GM spends a Fear to reveal you. While Spectral, you can bypass cameras, laser grids, and other security-controlled barriers as though you had the proper access. This doesn’t allow you to pass through solid walls or barriers with no plausible entry point.

Other creatures might still see brief signs of your passage.

Street Instinct.description:
Once per rest, when you enter a urban, ruined, or hostile environment, make an Instinct Roll (12). On a success, place a Street token on this card. On a success with Hope, place two instead.

Cover Line: When you are targeted by an attack from beyond Melee range, spend this token to gain a +2 to your Evasion against that attack.

Open Lane: Spend this token to move to a point within Far range.

Hazard Mark: When you deal damage, spend this token to add 1d6 damage. Clear all unspent tokens upon a rest.

Trapline Launcher.description: Make an Interface Roll against a target within Far range. On a hit, you fire a trapline at the target. They take 1d8+1 physical damage and turn Restrained. Additionally, you can spend a Hope to launch a secondary trapline at another adversary within Close range of the target, temporarily Restraining them.

Trail Reader.description:
When you track a specific creature, vehicle, or convoy, you can spend any number of Hope and ask the GM that many questions. When you encounter targets you’ve tracked in this way, gain a +1 to your Evasion against them:

1- What direction did they go?

2- How long ago did they pass by?

3- What were they doing here?

4- How many of them were here?

Field Swarm.description:
Guardian Swarm: Mark a Stress to release micro shield-drones that encircle you. When you take damage, reduce the severity by one threshold. You can spend a Hope to keep the swarm active after taking damage.

Razor Swarm: Make an Interface Roll against all adversaries within Close range. Spend a Hope to send the swarm outward in a burst of micro-drone impacts. Targets you succeeded against take 2d8+3 physical damage.

Scout Companion.description:
Spend a Hope to call a cyber-beast or scout drone to your side until your next rest, you run Scout Companion again, or the companion is targeted by an attack. If you spend an extra Hope, you can call a companion that flies.

You can communicate with them, make an Interface Roll to command them to perform simple tasks, and mark a Stress to see through their eyes. When you deal damage to an adversary within Melee range of your companion, you add a d6 to your damage roll.

Corrosive Round.description:
Make an Interface Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, deal d6+4 techno damage using your Proficiency.

Additionally, mark 2 or more Stress to make them permanently Corroded.

While a target is Corroded, they take a -1 to their Difficulty for every 2 Stress you spent. This condition can stack.

Deployable Ascender.description:
Once per rest, you can deploy a anchor tower, climbing line, or rapid-build ascent rig within Close range that can be easily climbed. Its height can grow up to Far range.

Mark a Stress to use this protocol as an attack. Make an Interface Roll against an adversary or group of adversaries within Close range.

The erupting rig lifts targets you succeed against into the air and drops them, dealing d8 physical damage using your Proficiency.

Grapple Snare.description:
Make an Interface Roll against a target within Close range and choose one:

1- You pull the target into Melee range or pull yourself into Melee range of it.

2- You constrict the target and force them to mark 2 Stress.

3- All adversaries between you and the target must succeed on a Reaction Roll (13) or be caught by cables taking 3d6+2 physical damage.

On a success, the snare reaches out from your hands, gear, vehicle, or drone, causing the chosen effect and temporarily Restraining the target.

Forecast Model.description:
Once per rest, spend 2 Hope to run a tactical assessment of your current environment, using route data, terrain scans, local markings, gang signs, old maps, or survival instincts.

Ask the GM one yes or no question about the current area, route, danger, structure, or situation.

The GM answers truthfully based on what is currently present or reasonably detectable.

After receiving the answer, the next time you or an ally acts directly on this information, they gain a +2 bonus to their action roll.

Razor Mesh.description:
Once per rest, spend a Hope to coat yourself in razor mesh, reactive thorns, or defensive nanofibers and place a number of tokens equal to your Interface trait on this card.

When you take damage, you can spend any number of tokens to roll that number of d6s. Add the results together and reduce the incoming damage by that amount.

If you’re within Melee range of the attacker, deal that amount of damage back to them. When you take a rest, clear all unspent tokens.

Field Bunker.description:
Make an Interface Roll (13).

On a success, spend 2 Hope to deploy a survival bunker, natural barricade, scrap dome, hard-shell shelter, emergency cover, or rapid-build defensive structure that you and one ally can take cover within.

While inside the bunker, a creature can’t be targeted by attacks and can’t make attacks.

Attacks made against the bunker automatically succeed.

The bunker has the following damage thresholds and lasts until it marks 3 Hit Points. Place tokens on this card to represent marking Hit Points.

Thresholds: 15/30

Convoy Vehicles.description:
Spend any number of Hope to call or secure that many simple vehicles, bikes, beasts, cyber-mounts, drones, or survival transports that you and your allies can drive until your next long rest or the vehicles take any damage.

The vehicles double your land speed while traveling and, when in danger, allow you to move within Far range without having to roll.

Creatures driving a vehicles gain a -2 penalty to attack rolls and a +2 bonus to damage rolls.

Scavenger.description:
As an additional downtime move, roll a d6 to see what you scavenge.

Work with the GM to describe it and add it to your inventory as a consumable. Your party can carry up to five scavenged consumables at a time.

1- A unique ration, stimulant, or comfort item (Clear 2 Stress)

2- A beautiful relic, valuable trinket, or black-market find (Gain 2 Hope)

3- An old access chip, route marker, or field module (+2 to an Interface Roll)

4- A medical vial, trauma patch, or emergency stabilizer (Clear 2 HP)

5- A luck charm, loaded die, or old-world token (Reroll any die)

6- Choose one of the options above.

Frontier-Synced.description:
When 4 or more of the domain cards in your loadout are from the Frontier Competency, gain the following:

While you’re in a urband, ruined, or hostile environment, you gain a +2 bonus to your Interface Rolls.

Once per rest, you can double your Agility or Instinct when making a roll that uses that trait. You must choose to do this before you roll.

Survival Overclock.description:
Once per long rest, mark a Stress to activate a survival overclock, pushing your survival gear, reflex software, hazard filters, movement assists, terrain scanners, and emergency stimulants past their safe limits. Describe how you shift into survival mode, then place a d6 on this card with the 1 value facing up. While the Survival Overclock Die is active, you add its value to every action roll you make.

After you add its value to a roll, increase the Die’s value by one.

When the die’s value would exceed 6 or you take a rest, the overclock burns out and you must mark an additional Stress.

Field Markers.description:
Make an Interface Roll (13).

On a success, spend any number of Hope to create an equal number of field markers that appear at points you choose within Far range, providing the following benefits:

Allies gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls against adversaries within Very Close range of a marker.

Allies who marks an Armor while within Very Close range of a marker can mark an extra Armor.

A marker vanishes after granting a benefit or taking any damage.

Solar Flare Array.description:
Make an Interface Roll to unleash a blast of burning flare shells against all adversaries within Far range.

On a success, spend any number of Hope and force that many targets you succeeded against to make a Reaction Roll (14).

Targets who succeed take 3d20+3 techno damage. Targets who fail take 4d20+5 techno damage and are temporarily Blinded. While Blinded, they has disadvantage on attack rolls and can’t target anything beyond Close range unless they can perceive it through another sense.

Frontier Shrine.description:
After a long rest, place a number of tokens equal to the number of Frontier domain cards in your loadout and vault on this card.

When you would make an Interface Roll, you can spend any number of tokens after the roll to gain a +1 bonus for each token spent.

When you critically succeed on an Interface Roll for a Frontier protocol, gain a token.

When you take a long rest, clear all unspent tokens.

Zone Reconfiguration.description:
Make an Interface Roll (18).

Once per long rest on a success, you reconfigure the surrounding combat zone anywhere within Far range using field engineering gear, demolition charges, deployable barricades, construction drones, foamcrete, road spikes, cutting lasers, or compromised infrastructure.

For example, you can clear a path through dense debris, collapse unstable cover, open a breach through a wrecked zone, raise a wall of scrap and barricades, expose buried infrastructure, create a ramp or bridge, or alter the battlefield’s available cover. The change must be something that could plausibly be accomplished through machinery, demolition or construction.

Ruinbreaker Rig.description:
Mark a Stress to activate a heavy survival exo-rig built. While active, hydraulic braces lock into place, cutting tools unfold, armor plates shift, hazard filters overclock, and your gear enters full breach mode. You gain the following benefits:

When you succeed on an attack or Interface Roll, add +10 to damage. When you deal enough damage to defeat a creature within Close range, you strip usable plating, siphon a power cell, or trigger emergency repair foam and clear an Armor Slot.

You can’t be Restrained.

Before you make an action roll, you must spend a Hope. If you can’t, the rig overheats, locks, or burns through its emergency charge, and you revert to your normal state.

Zone Suppression Array.description:
Choose one of the following suppression modes and make an Interface Roll against all targets within Far range. Targets you succeed against experience its effects until the GM spends a Fear on their turn to end this protocol.

1- Cryofoam Flood: You rupture cryo-canisters, coolant lines, or emergency suppression tanks across the zone. Deal 2d20+8 techno damage and targets are temporarily Vulnerable.
